visual_synopsis: In a wood-panelled government office a mustached boss in a pinstripe suit looms over a young secretary at her computer and swings his arms at her in exaggerated slapstick blows. A second young woman in a white shirt and black vest carries a rolled-up document through the corridors, and the business repeats in a grand office under an Armenian coat of arms where a man chases her out, intercut with bug-eyed reaction close-ups of a mustached man in a striped shirt in a blue-lit lobby.
